comment: The slot-and-boss part of mitcad#1429 (GitHub mitcad/Mitcad#173), tools/ui-windows-fillet-boss-tangent-crash-test.ps1: a slot 85 between centres and 50 wide on xy (F1) extruded 15 (the plate, F2.b0), and a circle of the slot end's size at its second centre (F3) extruded 30 and joined (the boss): the plate's flat sides run tangentially into the boss's cylinder.
